1.author: dana-r
1.title: checkout: full-order refunds
1.body:
## Order refunds

Adds full-order refunds.

- `POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/refund` on checkout, exposed to clients through the gateway. Body: `reason`.
- The refund amount is the full amount the buyer was charged for the order.
- Placed and settled orders can be refunded. The order moves to `refunded`. The order row is locked from the status check to the status update, so two concurrent requests cannot both refund one order.
- For a settled order the seller was already paid, so the refund writes a payout adjustment and the seller's payout is corrected in the next settlement run.
- Emits `checkout.order_refunded` on the order stream and an `order.refunded` webhook, so downstream services and integrators see refunds the same way they see placements and cancellations.
- Migration 0008 adds the `refunds` table and an index for the refunds dashboard.

Tests cover the amount calculation and the new status moves.

comments.author: mkowalski
comments.body: Check-then-act race: two refund requests can both pass the `can_transition` check before either writes, and the buyer gets refunded twice. This needs a unique constraint or an optimistic version column. Blocking.

comments.body: If a subscriber endpoint is down, `dispatch` raises and the client gets a 500 after the refund already committed. Wrap it in try/except.
